body:
Your ask (31 Oct): 3 floors as ONE room, no cutscene between floors.
- Up 1 to 2 (left stairs), 2 to 3 (right stairs), down again; the dog follows on the steps.
- Walks round the open middle on floor 2 without falling.
- Player is a stand-in (farmer model).
The game needs real step heights, rail blockers and a camera on 3 floors (sent to Plan). Landing in front of each stair is too tight (asked Objects).

comments.text:
Done: up, up, down and round the middle; camera follows, no fade, no rail clipping.
Leftovers: dog tilts at the bottom turn; some paws float a little.

Updated: same moves on the changed shop (stairs moved back, handrail starts higher).
The dog now follows 1.4 m behind; no rail clipping.

short: Walk up and down the shop stairs, pet follows. OK?
source: Model movements 31 Oct: asks from the Objects chat
title: Pet Shop: stairs in one room, no fade
